explanation: The Holy Spirit who is the third person of the Trinity, here manifested as tongues of fire to equip the disciples with power.
Speech in foreign languages given by the Holy Spirit so that people from various nations could understand the gospel in their own native language.
The Jewish festival marking 50 days after Passover, when the law was given to Moses and which in Acts marked the birth of the church community.
The apostle Peter who here delivers his first public sermon to proclaim Jesus' resurrection and call people to repentance.
Describes that Jesus Christ came back to life from the dead, which is the core of Christian faith and proof of his divine nature.
The term for the ritual act where a person is washed with water as a confession of sin and incorporation into Jesus' church.
A deep inner change where one turns from a sinful lifestyle toward God, often accompanied by regret over past actions.
